nodes.title: Extract the subject-placeholder token grammar into a shared, feature-neutral module
nodes.summary: The placeholder regex, the kind/argument split at the first ':', and the subject-kind filter move out of simulation-subject-derivation.ts into a new shared/services/ module that file now composes, with its own exported behavior unchanged.

nodes.title: Route Configuration's text to the test panel's hook
nodes.summary: ConnectorTestPanel gains a required configurationText prop that ConnectorConfigurationDetailReadyView fills with its own live state.configuration.value and forwards into useTestConnectorPanel(connector, configurationText).

nodes.title: Placeholder-token grammar primitives proven at their new module
nodes.summary: Proves the three grammar primitives extracted into shared/services/connector-placeholder-token.ts (the regex, the kind/argument split at the first ':', and the subject-kind filter) directly against their own exports, covering the token-grammar edge cases the extraction's own criterion raises, while leaving simulation-subject-derivation.ts's two pre-existing spec files untouched as the proof that its own observable behavior did not change.

nodes.title: Proof for routing Configuration text into the test panel's hook
nodes.summary: Three new spec files prove configurationText reaches useTestConnectorPanel through both production call sites, by reading what each seam actually received back off the DOM rather than recording a call.

nodes.title: Connector test panel placeholder attributes, first review
nodes.summary: What four passes found over the parallel-delivered extraction of placeholder-parsing primitives and the configurationText prop route.
unproven: Configuration text that is not valid JSON, or not a plain object, still resolves to no placeholders through the extracted primitives, exactly as before the extraction.
connector-configuration-form-dialog.tsx's own ConnectorTestPanel call site supplies a configurationText value so the file continues to type-check and compile.
simulation-subject-derivation.ts imports these primitives from that new module rather than declaring them itself.
